translations.EN: Thanks. I needed that.

translations.EN: I appreciate that. It has been a rough stretch.

translations.EN: Thanks. Sometimes you just need to hear that.

translations.EN: That helps steady my nerves. Thank you.

translations.EN: I did not know how much I needed to hear that. Thanks.

translations.EN: Thank you. That takes some of the weight off.

translations.EN: Thanks for checking in on me.

translations.EN: Thanks for sticking with me.
